from clearml.automation.controller import PipelineController
pipeline = PipelineController(name="Task \"golden\" pipeline")
pipeline.add_parameter(name="threshold", default=0.75)
pipeline.add_step(name="extract_data", base_task_id="base-task-extract", execution_queue="gpu-a", cache=True, retry_on_failure=2)
pipeline.add_step(name="publish_model", base_task_id="base-task-publish", execution_queue="gpu-a", cache=False, retry_on_failure=1)
pipeline.bind(kind="artifact", source="extract_data.artifact-model", target="publish_model.parameter-model_uri")
pipeline.bind(kind="parameter", source="parameter:threshold", target="publish_model.parameter-threshold")
pipeline.publish_output(name="trained_model", source="extract_data.artifact-model")
